ARTIVA LABORAL · Legal information

Privacy policy

How we process the information you provide when contacting Artiva Laboral.

01

Controller

The data controller is Artiva Laboral. Privacy contact: info@artivalaboral.com.

02

Data processed

Name, organisation, email, phone, service requested, message content and the technical data strictly necessary to receive and protect the form.

03

Purpose and legal basis

We process data to answer the enquiry, assess a possible professional relationship and, if engaged, manage it. The basis is your request for pre-contractual steps, consent where applicable and subsequent legal obligations.

04

Recipients

The form uses FormSubmit as the technical email-delivery provider. Information is transmitted to that provider when the form is sent. Essential hosting and email providers may also process data. Data is not sold or shared for marketing.

FormSubmit · privacy information ↗

05

Retention

Enquiries are kept as long as needed to answer and, as a general rule, for up to 12 months where no professional relationship begins. If it does, applicable statutory and claims periods apply.

06

Your rights

You may request access, correction, erasure, objection, restriction and portability, or withdraw consent, by writing to info@artivalaboral.com. You may also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency.

Agencia Española de Protección de Datos ↗

07

Security and changes

We apply reasonable safeguards to protect information. This policy will be reviewed when services, providers or processing activities change.
